diagnosis: The export job is 4 GB and has been running for nine hours, which exceeds the expected <1 hour completion time for jobs under 10 GB. According to internal guidelines, jobs running longer than six hours are considered stalled and should be cancelled and resubmitted.
reply:
Hi,

Export jobs under 10 GB typically finish within an hour. Since your 4 GB export has been running for nine hours, it appears to have stalled. Please cancel the current export job (EXP-40128) and start a new export. If the new job also stalls, let us know and we’ll investigate further.

Thanks for your patience.
